Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photorealistic 16:9 landing-page product hero with copy and CTA placed later on the left.
Image 1: edit target and authority for scene, composition, product positions, food, props, lighting, camera, crop, shadows, and color.

Primary request: Change only the individual packaging on both yogurt cups. Remove every paper, fiber, beige collar, wrap, label, sleeve, paper seam, paper window, and opaque backing from both cups. Replace each with one transparent food-grade low-wide cup of the same size, position, proportions, rim, and fill level as the corresponding cup in Image 1. Apply minimal direct black exterior print directly on the transparent wall of each cup, with only the exact text "MORA" and beneath it "THYME HONEY", clean modern sans serif, no surrounding panel and no extra characters.

Open cup: preserve the exact dense ivory Greek yogurt, thyme flecks, amber honey ribbon, surface ridges, clear rim, and open state from Image 1. The black direct print must sit on the clear wall and the yogurt must remain visible behind and around it.
Sealed cup: preserve the exact flat silver full-perimeter peelable foil, asymmetrical tab, yogurt visible through the clear wall, position, and scale from Image 1. Direct black "MORA" / "THYME HONEY" print only on its transparent wall.

Preserve exactly: wide 1672:941 composition; both cup positions and sizes on the right; broad uninterrupted low-detail copy-safe negative space covering the left half; spoon with yogurt, thyme sprig, food styling, gray mineral tabletop and backdrop, camera angle, depth behavior, strong upper-left directional light, contact shadows, cast shadows, highlight placement, neutral gray grade, and crop. Keep all product silhouettes, shadows, reflections, props, and high-contrast edges out of the left copy-safe region.

Material realism: plausible clear polymer wall thickness and refraction, food pressed naturally against the inner wall, physically correct rim and foil contact, restrained condensation-free studio surface, crisp black ink following the cup curvature, natural minor surface variation, unified single-source shadows, no CGI gloss.

Constraints: no individual paper or fiber anywhere; no adhesive label; no shrink sleeve; no opaque white or beige backing; no color ink; no ingredient-color marker; no flavor illustration; no rigid lid; no extra package, hand, utensil, garnish, text, logo, watermark, caption, or border. Keep everything else the same.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photorealistic packaging feature explainer / material-anatomy image for a website.
Image 1: edit target and authority for background, camera, lighting, food, foil, spoon, outer two-cup molded-fiber carrier, shadows, tonal grade, crop, and object scale.

Primary request: Remove the individual paper/fiber collar component completely, including its front panel, cutout, seam, locking tab, shadow, and every trace of it. Do not replace it with any sleeve, label, band, card, or fifth component. Keep exactly four object groups in the frame and arrange them as a clear left-to-right material separation:
1) left: the same transparent low-wide primary food-contact cup filled with the exact thyme-honey yogurt from Image 1;
2) center-left: the same separate flat silver full-perimeter peelable foil with pull tab;
3) foreground: the same single metal spoon;
4) right: the same empty outer two-cup molded-fiber carrier, clearly separate from the individual cup.

Apply minimal direct black exterior print directly onto the transparent wall of the food cup, only the exact text "MORA" and beneath it "THYME HONEY", clean modern sans serif, no opaque backing. Preserve the transparent cup wall, clear rim, exact dense ivory yogurt, amber honey ribbon, thyme flecks, fill level, food surface, and low-wide geometry. Food remains visible behind and around the black letters.

Composition: preserve the wide 1672:941 frame, high three-quarter viewpoint, gray mineral surface, generous upper negative space, and left-to-right anatomy read. After deleting the collar, rebalance spacing so each of the four object groups has clear air around it and no overlap: cup, foil, spoon, outer carrier. Keep the outer carrier unmistakably a two-cup transport component, not a single-cup collar.

Preserve exactly: camera angle, perspective, directional upper-left light, shadow direction and falloff, contact shadows, foil thickness and tab, spoon geometry, carrier pulp texture and two wells, neutral gray grade, background, crop, focus, and realistic food texture.

Material realism: plausible clear polymer thickness and refraction, crisp black ink following cup curvature, flat foil with actual thin edge, molded-fiber carrier with compressed pulp relief, unified single-source shadows, believable object contact and scale, no CGI gloss.

Constraints: exactly four object groups; no individual paper collar, label, sleeve, band, wrap, sticker, backing panel, extra cup, extra foil, lid, utensil, ingredient prop, hand, arrow, annotation, caption, diagram line, added logo, watermark, border, or extra text. No color ink and no flavor marker. Keep everything else the same.
